entries.reason: the method exists to turn a PKPushRegistry VoIP push payload into a reported call, and this port never receives one to turn: apsd on iOS 6.1.3, measured against real hardware (facts/PushKit/PushKit.md), ties every device token to a nonzero UIRemoteNotificationType bitmask (Badge/Sound/Alert) with no silent fourth bit, so a PKPushRegistry set up the way PushKit is meant to be used - with no prior -registerUserNotificationSettings: call - never receives a token at all; and apsd never wakes a suspended or not-running application for any push regardless. The wall is Apple's own push daemon on this release, not a version gate
entries.effect: the method is not there: respondsToSelector: answers NO and a compile time call crashes

entries.reason: the protocol is the callback surface CXCallDirectoryExtensionContext calls into, and that context is never created: iOS 6 has no app-extension infrastructure to load one into (facts/Foundation/CloudAndExtensions.md). The wall is the missing loader, not the protocol's own age
entries.effect: the protocol is not there: NSProtocolFromString answers nil
